name: sori
description: Sori: podcasts and YouTube into transcripts, then into training decks.

plugins.name: sori
plugins.description: Local podcast transcription and a searchable browser library. Optional CLI/plugin skills curate source-grounded learning briefs, review evidence and render editable decks or prepare manual slide handoffs. Local transcription needs no API key; AI client usage and optional paid API training have separate costs.
